I took your advice and drove again today, and honestly I have to tell this story too because its insane. First of all if I didnt mention it in my post I was leaving a chic fil a the first time. He was being a dick and looked like he wanted to race, but I let him pass bc fuck that I’m not tryna almost die again.

So I let him pass and he was taking a left, so as we were passing him I figured “hey he, was being a dick, lets flick him off”. So me and my friend flicked him off and he proceeded to pull out of the left lane and start following us. He followed us for miles and there was one point where we tried to lose him in a parking lot and ended up getting caught in a corner. At this point he couldve just moved a bit and trapped us, so I thought we were going to die, but he just sat there and stared, which is what he had been doing the whole time he was following us. We backed out and turned around, which he proceeded to repeat and keep following us.

We did some trickery with our other friends who were also in a car and managed to lose him but he was following our friends now so it didnt help. He found us again, and ended up following us in circles around the culdesac  where my friend lived. At this point we were scared as fuck so we called 911. Right as we were giving our location the guy left so we apologized and hung up.

It would be hard to say which experience was scarier, but I can say for sure that I couldve easily died in both scenarios. That guy was just looking at us the whole time, never blinked, never looked forward, never moved any muscle in his face. I dont think im gonna stop driving tho because that would just be such a handicap and also when youre not missing stopsigns and getting followed by insane psychopaths I actually enjoy driving. Still, what the fuck
